lines.trans: Oh, Samson. What have you come for?
Just once.
What do you mean, once?
Well, the thing you said.
Well, as you like. Lidia Alekseyevna, come in, please!
What's that for?
So that there are witnesses, Samson.
Lidia Alekseyevna, did you see everything?
Yes, Arkady Borisovich. I saw everything.
Now we're at peace.
Peace, peace. So when do I start work?
Listen, Samson, I've been thinking. Your boss is such an experienced specialist.
We can't fire him. It's not nice.
Then what am I going to be?
You go to the job centre. There's work there.
But you gave your word!
And what kind of mayor would I be if I kept my word?

examples.trans: Everything is ready on my side.

meanings.note: to one person you know well: friends, family, children

examples.trans: What are you going to be?

meanings.note: joining two parts of a sentence

examples.trans: What kind of mayor is that?

meanings.note: pointing at a thing or a situation; 'это' + noun = 'this is ...'
'что я за мэр такой' = what kind of mayor am I
refers back to the subject: 'он держит своё слово' = he keeps his word
joins a description to a noun; agrees with that noun in gender and number

examples.trans: This is a mayor who keeps his word.
Where is the book that was here?

meanings.note: starts a reply or softens it

говорить.gloss: to speak, to say, to talk

зайти.gloss: to come in, to drop in

meanings.en: to come in, to step in

examples.trans: I'll drop by in the evening.
I'm calling to say thank you.

meanings.note: the present 'is/are' is usually left out; 'есть' = there is / have
'буду' + imperfective infinitive: 'я не буду закрывать' = I won't close

examples.trans: I'll be there in ten minutes.

meanings.note: stressing the next word: 'вот теперь' = now then
after a change: 'теперь мир' = now there's peace
the end of a quarrel or war
the plural is used only in this sense

examples.trans: So when do I start work?
And you go to the job centre.
So when do I start work?

meanings.note: the imperative 'слушай' starts a sentence, like 'look, ...'
in 'я тут подумал' = I've been thinking

подумать.gloss: to think (for a while), to think it over

meanings.en: to think, to think it over

examples.trans: He is the head of the building site.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates

examples.trans: Are you going to fire me?
Then what am I going to be?

meanings.note: on foot, in one direction, now
a market where things are traded
a bit formal; 'биржа труда' = job centre

examples.trans: The job centre is over there.

meanings.note: adds force: 'ты же слово дал' = but you gave your word
'кризис же' = there's a crisis, you know
'дать слово' = to give one's word, 'держать слово' = to keep one's word
+ accusative: 'за что?' = what for?, 'за взятку' = for a bribe

examples.trans: What kind of mayor is that?
He is the mayor of the town.
The mayor is in the café.

meanings.note: ends a conversation or an order: 'Всё, свободен' = that's all, you can go
short form 'свободен' from a boss = you're dismissed
